name: Nishizawa Shizuku
source:
She is a neat-looking girl with a mature, ladylike appearance, but she is a devilish, calculating, and innocent bitch who plays with men on the palm of her hand. 

She loves money and brand-name goods, and makes a fortune through aiding others. She also has an uninhibited personality, and always has several boyfriends who are her purse holders and financial providers.

She is the most decent of the three in terms of grades and common sense, and often stops them from running amok.

She is always on the lookout for even richer men and the sons of wealthy families to seduce.

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk005/]official site[/url]]
